Language.Name: English
App.Title: Integrated Mod Manager Developer Tools
Shell.AutoRefreshHint: Reads the current page again every 5 seconds
Overview.Intro: A read-only look at the app's data folder: version, repositories, storage and key files. The tools never change the app's files.
Overview.AppRunning: The app is running. Viewing works as usual; clearing caches needs the app closed.
Repositories.Intro: Checks each repository's folders, launcher and deployment mode against the disk.
Repositories.Name: Name
Repositories.SourceFolders: Top-level folders in the Mod folder: {0}
Repositories.TargetFolders: Top-level folders in the target: {0}, of which {1} are directory links
Repositories.CopyModeHasLinks: Copy mode, but {0} directory links were found.
Records.Intro: Checks the copy records, state slots and directory links in target folders: whether the folders a record names still exist, whether a slot's Mod and picture are still there, and whether a link is broken. Read-only: nothing is changed.
Records.Kind.RecordForUnknownRepository: Copy record of a deleted repository
Records.Kind.RecordFolderMissing: The folder a copy record names is gone
Records.Kind.RecordSourceMissing: The source of a copy record is gone
Records.Kind.RecordOutsideTarget: A copy record points outside the target folder
Records.Kind.SlotForUnknownRepository: State slot of a deleted repository
Records.Kind.SlotModMissing: A state slot's Mod is no longer in the repository
Records.Kind.SlotPreviewMissing: A state slot's picture is gone
Logs.Intro: The app's logs merged in time order, filtered by file, level, time and text; Follow reads the newest lines every 2 seconds.
Caches.Intro: The app's cache folder. Online data caches can be cleared; the app downloads them again when needed. The index database holds favorites and other data and is not cleared here. Clearing asks first, is not possible while the app runs, and never follows a link.
Caches.AppRunning: The app is running; close it to clear caches.
Caches.Kind.Regenerable: Online data; can be cleared and is downloaded again when needed
Caches.Kind.GameBananaProfile: The GameBanana page's sign-in for likes; after clearing you sign in again
Caches.Kind.Kept: Kept: holds user data or tools; not cleared here
Caches.ConfirmRegenerable: This deletes the cached files in this folder; the app downloads them again when it next needs them. Repositories, Mods, presets and settings are not affected.
Caches.ConfirmProfile: This deletes the sign-in and page data the GameBanana page in the manager saved; you will need to sign in again to like Mods. Your sign-in in your browser is not affected. The same as the app's Settings → Clear GameBanana sign-in.
Caches.Result.AppRunning: The app is running; {0} was not cleared.
Caches.Result.Link: {0} is a link and was not cleared.
ModKeys.Intro: For Mod authors: reads a Mod's INI key bindings the way the app's Shortcuts page and overlay do, and shows whether each key can be sent. Read-only: the INI files are not changed.
ModKeys.PickMod: Pick a Mod of the current repository
ModKeys.NoneYet: Pick a Mod to see its key bindings.
ModKeys.Summary: {0} key bindings: {1} can be sent, {2} cannot.
ModKeys.Reason.Contradictory: A key both required and excluded
Translations.Intro: For translators: compares the UI language files in a folder (such as a source checkout's src\WinUI3\Strings) with a reference language: missing keys (shown in English), extra keys, placeholders the app cannot fill, and empty texts. Read-only.
Translations.NotYet: Choose the folder with the language files, then Compare. The package embeds the app's texts, so use a source checkout's src\WinUI3\Strings.
Translations.NoFiles: That folder has no .json language files.
Translations.ReadFailed: Could not read the language files: {0}
Files.Intro: The app's settings files and logs as text: search, check the JSON, copy or save a copy. These files are never changed.
Diagnostics.Intro: Creates a sanitized diagnostic report (this computer's paths and your user name replaced) that stays on this computer; you decide whether to attach it to an issue report. The tools never upload anything.
Diagnostics.ExportHint: A ZIP: a summary (versions, settings data counts, overlay settings, cache sizes, record checks) plus the sanitized settings files and logs
Diagnostics.SnapshotHint: Copies beta-shell.json and config.ini into the tools' own folder; the app is not changed.
Diagnostics.Preview: Summary preview (the same as summary.txt in the report)
